```{r}
test_df = split_dab_df_list[[10]] %>% select(-c(Conc., Replicates))
test_df

betweenGroupVariance = function(dataframe){
  # dataframe provided to this function needs to contain the target_vector column
  # and just the fluorescence values
  group_means = dataframe %>% group_by(target_vector) %>% summarise(across(everything(), mean))
  colMeans = dataframe %>% summarise(across(-target_vector, mean))
  
  num_cols = ncol(group_means)
  
  groupVariance = data.frame('target_vector' = group_means[1])
  group_means = group_means %>% select(-target_vector)
  
  for (ind in 1:(num_cols-1)){
    colVariance = (24 * (group_means[ind] - colMeans[[1]]) ^ 2)
    groupVariance = groupVariance %>% bind_cols(colVariance)
  }
  
  sumVariance = groupVariance %>% summarise(across(-target_vector, sum))
  # sumVariance = colSums(groupVariance[2:num_cols])
  sumVariance = sumVariance / 3
  
  return(sumVariance)
}

ssb = betweenGroupVariance(test_df)
ssb
```

```{r}
# Within group variance
withinGroupVariance = function(dataframe){
  # dataframe provided to this function needs to contain the target_vector column
  # and just the fluorescence values
  group_means = dataframe %>% group_by(target_vector) %>% summarise(across(everything(), mean))
  labels = unique(dataframe$target_vector) 
  global_dif_df = NULL
  for (label in labels){
    temp_dif_df = NULL
    var_df = dataframe %>% filter(target_vector == labels)
    label_group_means = group_means %>% filter(target_vector == label)
    for (ind in 2:15){
      dif = (var_df[ind] - label_group_means[[ind]])^2
      if (is.null(temp_dif_df)){
        temp_dif_df = dif
      }
      else{
        temp_dif_df = bind_cols(temp_dif_df, dif)
      }
    }
    if (is.null(global_dif_df)){
      global_dif_df = temp_dif_df
    }
    else{
      global_dif_df = bind_rows(global_dif_df, temp_dif_df)
    }
  }
  global_dif_df
  ssw = global_dif_df %>% summarise(across(everything(), sum))
  return(ssw)
}

ssw = withinGroupVariance(test_df)

f_ratio_df = (ssb / ssw) %>% pivot_longer(cols = everything(),
                                          names_to = 'pairs',
                                          values_to = 'f_ratio') %>%
  arrange(across(f_ratio, desc)) %>%
  mutate('normalized_f_ratio' = f_ratio / max(f_ratio))

f_ratio_df
```

```{r warning=FALSE}
# Preprocessing data for testing models with variance-based method
variance_fs_function = function(dataframe){
  fold_ind = createFolds(dataframe[['target_vector']], k=5)
  for (fold in 1:5){
    train_data = dataframe[-fold_ind[[fold]], ]
    test_data = dataframe[fold_ind[[fold]],]
    
    # May add box-cox to this method
    preProc = preProcess(train_data, method = c('center','scale'))
    scale_train = predict(preProc, train_data)
    scale_test = predict(preProc, test_data)
    
    # Subset training data by variance
    ssb = betweenGroupVariance(scale_train)
    ssw = withinGroupVariance(scale_test)
    
    f_ratio = (ssb / ssw) %>% pivot_longer(cols = everything(),
                                          names_to = 'pairs',
                                          values_to = 'f_ratio') %>%
    arrange(across(f_ratio, desc)) %>%
    mutate('normalized_f_ratio' = f_ratio / max(f_ratio))
    
    ranked_pairs_variance = f_ratio[['pairs']]
    top_10 = ranked_pairs_variance[1:10]
    top_5 = ranked_pairs_variance[1:5]

    top_10_train = scale_train %>% select(c('target_vector', top_10))
    top_5_train = scale_train %>% select(c('target_vector', top_5))
    
    top_10_test = scale_test %>% select(c('target_vector', top_10))
    top_5_test = scale_test %>% select(c('target_vector', top_5))
    
    
    train_control = trainControl('repeatedcv',
                                 repeats = 3,
                                 number = 3)
    model_10 = train(target_vector~.,
                  data = top_10_train,
                  method = 'rf',
                  tuneLength = 10)
    
    model_5 = train(target_vector~.,
              data = top_5_train,
              method = 'rf',
              tuneLength = 10)
    
    print(model_10$results)
    print(model_5$results)
    
    print(model_10$bestTune)
    print(model_5$bestTune)
    preds_10 = predict(model_10,
                       newx=top_10_test)
    
    preds_5 = predict(model_5,
                      newx=top_5_test)
    
    acc10 = Accuracy(preds_10, top_10_test[['target_vector']])
    acc5 = Accuracy(preds_5, top_5_test[['target_vector']])
    
    print(acc10)
    print(acc5)
  }
}
var_test_df = test_df
var_test_df
variance_fs_function(test_df)
```
